subject: POC access & network roadmap for AzuraHealth - API keys, org setup, IP/VPC steps
messages:
From: Ellen Ramirez <ellen.ramirez@azurahealth.com>
To: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@azurahealth.com>, netops@azurahealth.com
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC access & network checklist - AzuraHealth

Hi Markus,

Thanks for the walkthrough earlier. We're ready to land the mutual action plan so we can get the POC live next week. Attached is our internal network diagram (azura_network_v1.pdf) and a short list of constraints. High-level asks from our side: 

- Organization and billing setup (we want to pin to our billing owner)
- API key provisioning and scoping for dev vs staging tokens
- IP allowlist ranges for initial peering test (we can open a maintenance window)
- VPC peering option and a preferred date window for the peering cutover

Can you send a concrete set of tasks and owners, with the earliest recommended dates? We have procurement finishing on Mon 6/21 and would like the environment live by 6/25 if possible.

Also include any docs or templates we should return (e.g., network ACL template, CIDR expectations).

Thanks,
Ellen Ramirez
Head of Platform Engineering
AzuraHealth

Attachment: azura_network_v1.pdf
From: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Ramirez <ellen.ramirez@azurahealth.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@azurahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC access & network checklist - AzuraHealth

Ellen — thanks for the clear ask and the diagram. I've sketched a concise MAP below that aligns with your procurement timeline. Attaching a formal checklist and a working MAP spreadsheet (MAP-AzuraHealth-20270618.xlsx).

Quick summary (owner / target date):
- Org + billing setup: lauren_bishop / 2027-06-20 (we'll send the invite to your billing contact)
- API key provisioning (dev/staging scoped keys): lauren_bishop / 2027-06-21
- IP allowlist for initial testing (static list): netops@azurahealth.com provides ranges by 6/19; we validate and add by 6/20 — owner: priyom_das / 2027-06-20
- VPC peering test window: proposed 2027-06-24 02:00-04:00 PT (low traffic). Owner: priyom_das & AzuraNetOps / 2027-06-24
- Final smoke tests & acceptance: AzuraHealth sign-off 6/25 EOD

Notes and constraints:
- For the POC we recommend using token-based API keys scoped to two org roles (dev: limited throughput, staging: higher throughput). We will not enable production tokens until SLA and dedicated capacity are signed.
- VPC peering requires route table adjustments on your side. See the attached network template.
- If you prefer SCP or a private endpoint instead of peering, we can propose that as a follow-up.

Next steps I propose:
1) Ellen/Samir confirm the IP ranges and preferred peering window by EOD 6/19.
2) Lauren will send the org invite and provisioning link for API keys by 6/20.
3) Priyom will schedule the peering maintenance and share step-by-step docs.

I've attached: redwood_map_poc_checklist.pdf and MAP-AzuraHealth-20270618.xlsx (working).

Should we lock the 6/24 peering window now or wait for your confirmation?

— Markus Klein
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood_map_poc_checklist.pdf, MAP-AzuraHealth-20270618.xlsx
From: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Ramirez <ellen.ramirez@azurahealth.com>, markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@azurahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC access & network checklist - AzuraHealth

Ellen — looping in next steps on the org and API side. A couple of operational details so there are no surprises: 

- Org setup: I'll create the AzuraHealth org in Redwood and invite your billing contact as Owner. Please confirm the billing email. Once accepted, billing ownership change takes ~24 hours.
- API key types: we will provision two API key templates today (dev & staging). Keys will be delivered via the console and a one-time export link. Keys are rotatable; please confirm if you need KMS-backed keys (we support customer-managed KMS for Private deployments, but for Hosted POC we recommend Redwood-managed KMS).
- Token permissions: dev keys will be rate-limited to 10 RPS and a hard token TTL of 7 days; staging will be 50 RPS and 30 day TTL. If you need higher throughput for evaluation bursts, flag it and we can temporarily raise the quota.

Action items for AzuraHealth (please reply inline):
- Confirm billing contact email (for org invite)
- Provide IP ranges for allowlist by 6/19 (CIDR format preferred)
- Approve 6/24 02:00-04:00 PT peering window or propose alternate

Priyom — I'll hand off the network checklist and the peering runbook to you after Azura posts ranges. Priyom, can you draft the specific peering commands for their AWS console (or GCP equivalent) and the expected route table changes?

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Product Manager, Customer Onboarding
Redwood Inference

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@azurahealth.com>
To: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ellen Ramirez <ellen.ramirez@azurahealth.com>, netops@azurahealth.com, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC access & network checklist - AzuraHealth

Thanks — this looks good. Quick responses inline and a couple of asks: 

- Billing contact: finance-ops@azurahealth.com (please send invite to that address).
- IP ranges: netops@azurahealth.com will send a CIDR list by COB 6/19; preliminary ranges attached in azura_network_v1.pdf.
- Peering window: 6/24 02:00-04:00 PT works for our environment. We'll assign an on-call network engineer (Priya Kumar) to the maintenance window. Expect a short connectivity blip during route propagation; we will validate via the smoke tests you outlined.
- DocuSign/PO: Procurement will need a statement of work and T&Cs to process any credit/limit changes; please provide a link to the SOW or a marketplace listing.

Netops contact: Priya Kumar <priya.kumar@azurahealth.com> (cc'd on netops alias). Priya will coordinate peering commands with Priyom next week.

We confirm acceptance of the MAP items and target the 6/25 sign-off after the smoke tests. Please share the API key export link when available.

— Samir
Senior Engineering Manager
AzuraHealth

Attachment: azura_network_v1.pdf (referenced)
